## Expected Outcome

Create one focused grammar entry for the specified topic, following the repository's grammar instructions and JSON template.

- Follow the approved grammar categories and classification rules.
- Follow `instructions/grammar/instruction.md`.
- Match the structure defined in `instructions/grammar/template.json`.
- Use natural, contemporary British English and accurate British English IPA.
- Provide the depth and precision appropriate for C2-level proficiency and high-band IELTS performance.
- Keep the entry focused on the requested grammar topic.
- Do not introduce fields or structures that are not defined by the template.
